stem: Voltmarkt's finance director asks about Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices: "What percentage of the MRR we had on 1 September did existing businesses take away in September by cancelling or moving to a cheaper plan?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: 100 × businesses that cancelled / businesses at the start
100 × (churn MRR + contraction MRR) / MRR at the start
100 × the cohort's MRR at the end / its MRR at the start
MRR at the start / businesses active at the start
